entities.name: Étienne-Jean Georget
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Étienne-Jean Georget was a French psychiatrist. He is known for writing on monomania. He is also the pioneer of forensic psychiatry, and was the first psychiatrist to discuss the defence of insanity to criminal charges.
